description: DataForSEO is a pay-as-you-go SEO/SERP data API provider (keyword data, backlinks, SERP results, on-page analysis).
access_notes: Account creation is free, but the API itself is strictly pay-as-you-go with no meaningful free usage tier -- you fund an account balance before making calls (third-party pricing summaries cite plans starting around $50).
api_notes: SERP, keyword research (Labs), backlinks, on-page, and domain analytics endpoints -- a wide SEO data surface.
main_blocker: No free usage tier -- every call requires a funded, paid account balance.
